Fields.Name: Ailment Damage Multiplier: Sleep
Fields.Description: Multiplies the HP damage of sleep effects for NG+ scaling SpEffects. The game applies it to the SpEffect's frostbite damage correction, since sleep damage uses that value. 0 or less: ignored (x1).

Fields.Name: Ailment Damage Multiplier: Madness
Fields.Description: Multiplies the madness damage correction of NG+ scaling SpEffects (the HP damage a madness proc deals). 0 or less: ignored (x1).
